title: Tiered indemnity exception scorer and MSA/DPA redline decision flow
creator: Asha Gupta
description: Scope: Define a repeatable decision flow for handling indemnity/liability redlines on MSAs and DPAs, plus a lightweight scoring mechanism for auto-approving low-risk exceptions tied to pricing/packaging experiments. This ticket captures the product acceptance criteria, negotiation guardrails for sales, and a phased roll-out plan for automation. Goals: 1) Reduce time-to-execution for standard enterprise deals by enabling auto-approve for low-risk concessions; 2) Provide clear escalation and fallback paths for higher-risk indemnity/liability asks; 3) Align commercial packaging experiments (discount bands, add-on entitlements) with legal risk thresholds so Sales & Legal can operate with consistent SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented decision matrix mapping indemnity/limitation-of-liability/escrow clauses to risk tiers (low/medium/high). 2) A scoring spreadsheet prototype that takes clause type + customer attributes (revenue band, data classification, sector) and outputs an approval action: auto-approve / require legal review / require executive approval. 3) A playbook for Sales with templated clause language and fallback pricing adjustments when indemnity is limited. 4) Integration checklist for engineering to surface exception telemetry in Console (per-deal label and audit log). 5) Legal & Security sign-off on scoring thresholds and automated workflows.
decision: We will adopt a conservative scoring baseline: auto-approve for low-risk clauses with customer revenue < $2M and data classification <= internal; medium-risk requires Legal review and can be approved by Legal lead within 48 hours; high-risk (e.g., unlimited liability, broad indemnities for third-party IP) requires Executive approval and an alternate commercial concession (price holdback or escrow). Sales will surface requests via a standardized intake form; exceptions will be tracked in the Contracts dashboard. Pricing experiments will default to non-escrow pricing unless Legal signs off.
